title: Transition coherence from pinned natural equivalences
statement: theorem perfect_hom_open_restricted_pinned_maps {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) {i : I} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (B : Y.Opens) (a : derivedPullback B.ι ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι) (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F) (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) (e : PerfectHomOpenRestrictedEquivFields R c s B Q F d) (hs : ∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : M ⟶ F.obj j), e.stageEquiv j ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj M) ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).map f) = perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))) a (h.stageEquiv j M f)) (hl : ∀ (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : M ⟶ d.pt), e.limitEquiv ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj M) ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).map f) = perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) a (h.limitEquiv M f)) : (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (M : schemeDerivedCategory B.toScheme) (f : M ⟶ (F ⋙ schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj j), e.stageEquiv k M (f ≫ (F ⋙ schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).map (homOfLE hjk)) = perfectStageMap R (B.ι ≫ s) j.property hjk (e.stageEquiv j M f)) ∧ (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (M : schemeDerivedCategory B.toScheme) (f : M ⟶ (F ⋙ schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj j), e.limitEquiv M (f ≫ ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).mapCocone d).ι.app j) = perfectLimitMap R c (B.ι ≫ s) j.property (e.stageEquiv j M f))

proof.text: At the identity of L(F_j), substitute pinning for the original transition morphism and identity. The original stageMap and limitMap equations and cartesian transport commutation prove the restricted transition and cocone equations at these identities.

For arbitrary f:N → L(F_j), use e.stageNatural/e.limitNatural. Naturality of perfectHomMap is obtained by expanding the conjugation and using comparison naturality. Both desired sides are pullback(f) followed by the already proved identity values. This proves every transition and cocone equation.
